channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Plans for 'mammoth eyesore' set to be thrown out after uproar in posh seaside village
item.description: Plans to tear down a chalet in Old Hunstanton and replace it with a much-larger home look set to be thrown out after a furious row in the exclusive coastal village.

item.title: Privacy concerns raised over plans to convert flats
item.description: Neighbours have raised concerns over privacy and parking another bid to expand Legarda Court flats

item.title: Townhouse which dodged demolition could be given new lease of life
item.description: A Georgian townhouse in St Giles Street could be given a new lease of life.

item.title: Bathroom and kitchen showroom could get revamp to shopfront
item.description: Plans have been revealed for Atlantic Bathrooms and Kitchens to change its shopfront signage at its Waterloo Road showroom.

item.title: Council pursued Sheringham bus shelter revamp despite 74pc of people opposing it
item.description: Sheringham's bus shelter saga has taken a fresh twist after new figures showed Norfolk County Council pursued the revamp plans - despite 74pc of consultees opposing it.

item.title: 'We've not given up' - Norwich Western Link revival among council's 2026 priorities
item.description: Norfolk County Council leaders have insisted they have still not given up on getting the Norwich Western Link built, saying it is a 'top priority' for 2026.

item.title: Bark a leg! Support puppies welcomed for 'great opportunity' at city theatre
item.description: They say never work with animals, but Norwich Theatre Royal has made an exception for a group of fluffy, four-legged friends.

item.title: Rising childhood poverty in Norfolk being tackled by new organisation
item.description: A new social enterprise has delivered its first bed to a family in need.

item.title: Call for well-wishers to shower 'wonderful' woman with cards on 100th birthday
item.description: A Suffolk care home is calling on kind-hearted people to show their support for a "wonderful" woman.

item.title: Faulty pump at flood hotspot replaced
item.description: A faulty pump believed to be behind a flooding hotspot in Acle has been replaced as work to prevent the return of floodwater continues.
